sentences.text:
Author: Jay Sengupta
Bench: Jay Sengupta
Court No. C.R.R. 1379 of 2025 Item 343 ssi 09.04.
In the matter of:- Debjyoti Ghosh @ Debajyoti 2025 Ghosh & ors.
Mr. Bibek Chatterjee Ms. Paramita Sahu Ms. T. Kumari Sharma ...for the petitioners Learned counsel appearing on behalf of the petitioners submits as follows.
Although a charge sheet was submitted under Section 498A of the Code, charges were framed also under Section 406 of the Indian Penal Code.
Let the petitioners serve a copy of this application upon the State through the learned Public Prosecutor and upon the private opposite party by speed post with acknowledgment due, within a week.
An affidavit of service to that effect shall be filed on the next date.
List this matter for hearing under the same heading after three weeks.

(Jay Sengupta, J.)
